diagram_review.check: First square: composable (f,g) maps to g; left map records (f,Cone(g)); the lower c×id and right s×t both record (source(g),Cone(g)). Second: (f,g) maps to h; left records (source(f), k); lower id×c and right s×t both record (source(h),Cone(h)), with source(h)=source(f). Both orientations and object indices are consistent. The proof independently reconstructs the pullbacks.

The source fixes ordered basis (m,l), columns as images, positive Hopf s_+ sends m↦−l,l↦m and positive twist t sends m↦m,l↦l+m, then distinguishes S²=C from inverse-pair (S⁻¹T)³=κC. A small labeled torus/basis map could help readers audit the orientation, but the complete matrices and conventions are explicit; not a required addition.
